TABLE.NAME: auth_kabtelegram_links
TABLE.COMMENT: Telegram account linked to a Moodle account: one Telegram per account, one account per Telegram

FIELD.NAME: tgusername
FIELD.COMMENT: Telegram username at the last login or link, may be empty

FIELD.NAME: tgname
FIELD.COMMENT: First and last name from Telegram, to show which Telegram is linked

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: wp: imported from the old WordPress site; user: linked by the user

FIELD.NAME: lastauthdate
FIELD.COMMENT: auth_date of the last Telegram answer accepted; older or equal ones are refused

FIELD.NAME: timelastlogin
FIELD.COMMENT: Last sign-in through Telegram, 0 if never
